description: This file defines the FutureAction trait and its implementations for handling asynchronous Spark actions with support for cancellation, including classes for single and multiple job actions, as well as a Java wrapper.

classes.name: FutureAction
classes.description: Trait extending Scala's Future to support cancellation and additional control over Spark actions.

classes.name: SimpleFutureAction
classes.description: Implementation of FutureAction for actions that trigger a single Spark job, supporting cancellation and result retrieval.

classes.name: ComplexFutureAction
classes.description: Implementation of FutureAction for actions that may trigger multiple Spark jobs, with cancellation support.

classes.name: JobSubmitter
classes.description: Trait providing a method to submit Spark jobs with cancellation capability.

classes.name: JavaFutureActionWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class to expose FutureAction as a Java Future, with conversion support.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the execution of the action, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Blocks until the action completes or the specified timeout elapses.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns the result of the action, throwing exceptions if occurred.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked upon completion.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the action has completed.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the action has been cancelled.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an Option containing the result or exception if completed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Blocks and retrieves the result, with support for timeout.

methods.name: jobIds
methods.description: Returns the IDs of jobs associated with the action.
